name: IsUniformInducing.equicontinuousAt_iff
statement: ι → X → α} {x₀ : X} {u : α → β} (hu : IsUniformInducing u) : EquicontinuousAt F x₀ ↔ EquicontinuousAt ((u ∘ ·) ∘ F) x₀

name: IsUniformInducing.equicontinuousWithinAt_iff
statement: ι → X → α} {S : Set X} {x₀ : X} {u : α → β} (hu : IsUniformInducing u) : EquicontinuousWithinAt F S x₀ ↔ EquicontinuousWithinAt ((u ∘ ·) ∘ F) S x₀

name: IsUniformInducing.uniformEquicontinuous_iff
statement: ι → β → α} {u : α → γ} (hu : IsUniformInducing u) : UniformEquicontinuous F ↔ UniformEquicontinuous ((u ∘ ·) ∘ F)

name: IsUniformInducing.uniformEquicontinuousOn_iff
statement: ι → β → α} {S : Set β} {u : α → γ} (hu : IsUniformInducing u) : UniformEquicontinuousOn F S ↔ UniformEquicontinuousOn ((u ∘ ·) ∘ F) S

name: EquicontinuousAt.tendsto_of_mem_closure
statement: Filter ι} {F : ι → X → α} {f : X → α} {s : Set X} {x : X} {z : α} (hF : EquicontinuousAt F x) (hf : Tendsto f (𝓝[s] x) (𝓝 z)) (hs : ∀ y ∈ s, Tendsto (F · y) l (𝓝 (f y))) (hx : x ∈ closure s) : Tendsto (F · x) l (𝓝 z)

have_tree.type: ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝[s] x, y ∈ s ∧ (∀ i, (F i x, F i y) ∈ V) ∧ (f y, z) ∈ V
